title.narrative: Providing shelter and rehabilitating homes damaged by the earthquake in Aleppo Governorate, Syrian Arab Republic

description.narrative: 432 homes will be rehabilitated to their pre-earthquake condition through general restoration of basic and service elements of the home and replacement of damaged ones. Basic needs will also be provided, such as providing electricity through solar panels and installing modern water tanks.

432 houses were rehabilitated to their pre-earthquake condition through general restoration of basic and service elements of the house and replacement of damaged ones. Houses and temporary housing units will also be provided through the project with basic needs such as providing electricity through solar panels, installing modern water tanks, providing ventilation, etc.
Completion of the rehabilitation of approximately 432 homes and handing over a number of housing units to the most affected beneficiaries (3,096) .
